credit: Flute: original composition for this website
temperament: equal (the temple sounds, to match the recording)

recording.source: Made with Suno on the site owner's paid account; the owner owns the song (stated 2026-11-02).
recording.note: A recording, used as it is: decoded, resampled to 44.1 kHz, its digital silence trimmed, a 10 ms fade-in, one fixed gain; then the gap of silence before it starts again. Made with tools/use-recording.mjs.

crossfade.note: Only for the xfade file: when A reaches loopSeconds + bAt, B (started at bAt) takes over over `seconds`; both play the same music. There is no plan for the plain file: a recording has no cycle to hand over on.

xfade.note: Samples [N, N+T) repeat [0, T). Crossfade two elements inside the tail: when A reaches loopSeconds + d, start B at d; both then play the same music (the same samples in the master; in the MP3, each copy with its own coding noise).

loop.note: The whole file is one loop: the recording, then its gap of silence. Decoders that read the gapless header (Chromium decodeAudioData, ffmpeg) return exactly `samples` samples. The site plays the xfade file with the crossfade above.

sfx.note: small brass hand-bell, struck (Sa = C6, Ga ringing above; A4 = 440.51 Hz)
soft conch swell on Sa (C4, A4 = 440.51 Hz); optional
